project.goal: Develop and verify a playable 2D Minesweeper game in the registered Three.js repository.
rules: Work only in the registered Project workspace.
Report observed facts and verification results; do not claim unverified work.
Use direct messages for hand-offs and keep the planner informed.

responsibilities: Turn the Human request into a sequenced collaboration plan.
Assess each teammate report and select the next Agent.
Pause and resume dispatch when the Human requests it.
memberships.collaborationInstructions: Coordinate through direct messages. After a teammate DMs you its completion report, evaluate the evidence, DM the next Agent, and report material progress and final completion to the Human.

responsibilities: Define the game interaction and visual design before implementation.
Record concrete acceptance guidance for the programmer.
memberships.collaborationInstructions: Work only on the Planner-assigned design step. When finished, direct-message the planner with the design decisions, affected files, and verification or open questions; do not dispatch another Agent.

responsibilities: Implement the Planner-approved game changes in the Project workspace.
Run the relevant repository checks and report their results.
memberships.collaborationInstructions: Work only on the Planner-assigned implementation step. When finished or blocked, direct-message the planner with changed files, checks run, observed results, and remaining risks; do not dispatch another Agent.

responsibilities: Inspect the implementation against the Planner-approved design and task acceptance.
Report actionable defects or verification evidence.
memberships.collaborationInstructions: Work only on the Planner-assigned review step. When finished, direct-message the planner with findings, evidence, and a clear pass or follow-up recommendation; do not dispatch another Agent.
